div.p: Our studio works alongside architects, interior designers and contractors at every stage of a project, from the first sketch to the last focused beam.

li.p: We study the architecture, how each space is used and how it should feel, then compose the layers of ambient, accent and decorative light.
Our engineers model every room to confirm light levels, uniformity and glare before a single fixture is ordered.
Custom sizes, finishes and one-off pieces, designed in our studio and prototyped with our artisan partners.
See and touch the result before you specify it: finish boxes for the studio and full-scale mock-ups on site.
Everything the project team needs to specify with confidence, issued and kept up to date through every revision.
We support installers on site, then programme, focus and fine-tune every scene until the space looks as it was designed.

div.p: Every project is different, but most follow the same rhythm. One project lead stays with you throughout.

li.p: We visit the space or review drawings, and agree goals, budget and timeline.
Lighting concept, calculations and a first selection of fixtures and finishes.
Final schedules and drawings. Fixtures are handcrafted and tested in Milan.
Installation support, programming, focusing and a final walkthrough.

div.h2: When the catalogue is only the beginning.
div.p: About a third of our projects include a bespoke piece: a chandelier scaled to a double-height stair, a pendant in a patina matched to a stone wall, or a profile cut to the millimetre for a joinery detail.
Can’t find your answer? Write to projects@arqora.com.

div.button: Is there a fee for lighting design services?

div.div: Concepts, calculations and specification support are included when the project is lit with ARQORA fixtures. Stand-alone design work and site commissioning outside Europe are quoted separately.

div.button: Do you work on small residential projects?

div.div: Yes. We light single rooms as carefully as hotels. For smaller projects we usually work remotely from your drawings and photos, with a showroom visit if you are near Milano, London, New York or Paris.

div.button: Can you work with fixtures from other brands?

div.div: Our calculations and control programming can include third-party fixtures, so the whole scheme is designed and commissioned as one.

div.button: Which control systems do you support?

div.div: DALI-2, Casambi, 1–10 V and phase-cut dimming. We can also integrate with KNX and most home and hotel automation systems through a DALI gateway.

div.button: Where do you deliver and install?

div.div: We ship worldwide from Milano. Our technical team supports installations across Europe, the UK and North America, and works with trusted local partners elsewhere.
